messages.subject: ab and total for each group when I try mediation with groups
parts:
Hi all,

I am a new user of lavaan and mediation. I would very much appreciate your answers.

How can I know ab and total for each group when I try mediation in lavaan with groups? I only see one ab and total in the bottom when I have two groups and different numbers for two groups.

Thanks,
New in mediation

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: ab and total for each group when I try mediation with groups
parts:
On 05/19/2015 07:24 PM, NewInMediation wrote:
> Hi all,
>
> I am a new user of lavaan and mediation. I would very much appreciate
> your answers.
>
> How can I know ab and total for each group when I try mediation in
> lavaan with groups? I only see one ab and total in the bottom when I
> have two groups and different numbers for two groups.

You need to use a different set of labels for each group. See:

http://lavaan.ugent.be/tutorial/groups.html

So if you have a simple mediation setup as in

m ~ x
y ~ x + m

then you will need to label them as follows (assuming two groups):

m ~ c(a1,a2)*x
y ~ c(c1,c2)*x + c(b1,b2)*m

and the you can define the indirect/total effects for each group as

ab1 := a1*b1
ab2 := a2*b2

total1 := c1 + (a1*b1)
total2 := c2 + (a2*b2)


Yves.
